task_estimates.task: Recover raw evidence and record reuse decisions
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse existing registries, reports and recovery scripts; verify missing raw artifacts and checkpoint identities.
Reuse mismatch audits and decoder tests; trace first divergence on a small matched-prefix sample before any large run.

task_estimates.task: Correct equations, data counts and cost statements
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse implementation audit, objective-selection studies and training summaries; repair manuscript/accounting offline.
Reuse the existing small reproducer; fix export and verify reload equivalence before drift experiments.

task_estimates.task: Audit data history and freeze final evaluation
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse overlap/similarity audits; inspect flagged cases and distinguish exposed historical data from new final data.

task_estimates.task: Validate historical main results and add independent final evidence
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Zero automatic historical main reruns. New allowance is one comparable-size independent final set across four pairs after the data audit; remove it if adequate independent evidence already exists.

task_estimates.task: Add inexpensive adaptation and closest-method controls
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse fitting/benchmark infrastructure and valid reference arms; pilot external compatibility, then bounded development screening and selected final comparisons.

task_estimates.task: Separate distinct training examples from update count
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Seven configurations share one central point; reuse any matching fits/evaluations. Seed replication is charged only to E14.

task_estimates.task: Compare linear and nonlinear maps at matched capacity
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse dense and existing nonlinear fits where protocols match; add missing matched-width linear controls, with residual extension conditional on pilot value.

task_estimates.task: Connect feature errors to draft behavior
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse descriptive geometry; add small common-prefix controls and accepted-prefix/cycle-time probes.

task_estimates.task: Complete current breadth controls and quality
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse 16 historical cells and scored outputs. Add only missing current plain-target paired controls/quality evidence. The new domain already charged in E05 is not counted again.
Reuse four completed transfer settings, including the Llama second-family result. Allow a small missing direct-map comparison or quality probe, not a new transfer suite.

task_estimates.task: Measure full setup and representative serving
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse valid isolated-memory measurements and profiling code; add full cold setup and one compatible engine pair at four concurrency settings and three input lengths.
Reuse the original seed when valid; four extra fits across two representative pairs, with evaluation. No best-seed selection.

task_estimates.task: Connect raw evidence to every paper asset
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Repair existing builders/registry bindings rather than rebuilding the pipeline; recompute tables and figures offline.
Reuse the paper, completed related-work review and framing blueprint; write evidence-supported contributions, results and limitations.

task_estimates.task: Final reproduction, PDF and anonymous package
task_estimates.reuse_and_scope: Reuse test/build infrastructure; fix stale audit records after actual PDF inspection and run a small clean-environment reproduction.

notes: All four measured main jobs are already spent and excluded from remaining base compute.
Existing evidence is reused when it meets the claim and measurement contract; artifact presence alone does not certify correctness.
Future ranges are planning judgments, not measured durations or probabilistic confidence intervals.
The 12–20 four-GPU-hour reserve is additive and covers justified affected reruns and ordinary failed pilots. Do not add the historical 7.7-hour full-main contingency again on top of it.
A paired timing result cannot be fabricated by combining a newly timed arm with an old control from a different execution; necessary matched controls count as affected work.
New independent data address exposure history, not a presumption that completed MATH-500 work must be repeated.
External baseline or serving incompatibility requiring a substantial port, whole-matrix invalidation or algorithm redesign require a revised estimate.
Active work overlaps GPU execution; queue waiting is separate and no queue-time distribution is known.
At most four GPUs allocated across all RelaySpec jobs at any time. Allocation-hour figures assume comparable hardware to the measured L40S runs.
No GPU jobs were launched for this estimate; completion statuses are unchanged.

calendar_assumptions.aggressive_conditions: Lower half of effort range, about eight productive hours daily, early correctness resolution, compatible baseline/engine paths and prompt GPU access.

remaining_work_estimate.scientific_validation_status: E00 and scientific gates remain incomplete; local artifact existence was inventoried, not certified as valid.
